items.source: /// Find one mapping by exact exposed identity. No prefix is interpreted.

items.name: mapping_for_client
items.source:
#[must_use]
pub fn mapping_for_client(
    client: ClientKind,
    models: &[String],
    exposed_id: &str,
    protocol: ClientProtocol,
) -> Option<RegistryEntry> {
    registry_for_client(client, models)
        .ok()?
        .into_iter()
        .find(|entry| entry.exposed_id == exposed_id && entry.protocol == protocol)
}

items.source: /// Whether any supported adapter registry contains this exact exposed id.

items.name: canonical_for_any_client
items.source:
#[must_use]
pub fn canonical_for_any_client(models: &[String], exposed_id: &str) -> Option<String> {
    [
        ClientKind::ClaudeCode,
        ClientKind::Codex,
        ClientKind::Opencode,
        ClientKind::GeminiCli,
        ClientKind::GrokCli,
        ClientKind::QwenCode,
    ]
    .into_iter()
    .filter_map(|client| registry_for_client(client, models).ok())
    .flatten()
    .find(|entry| entry.exposed_id == exposed_id)
    .map(|entry| entry.canonical_id)
}
